title: Start
body:
Lupe was studying at his friend’s house when he noticed an open diary on the desk.
Even though no one else was in the room,
he realized this was a test of his honesty and respect for his friend’s privacy.
What should Lupe do?
[[ A. Lupe will read it out of curiosity. |option4]]
[[ B. Lupe would take a picture of a page and spread it. |option5]]
[[ C. He will just close, return it and respect their privacy. |option6]]
